title: Read words open the store read-only and never create one
outcome: Read words open the store read-only and never create one
acceptance: A test shows that each of those words succeeds on an established store, as a live store has it with its SQLite shared-memory file present, in a process that cannot open the database or its WAL file for writing, and leaves their bytes unchanged.
docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md lists which words are reads that record nothing, and names the one memories form that records

ls, search, show in every form, and memories in every form that records nothing open the store through the read-only open that next with peek, core held and core inspect already use, or an equivalent that cannot write database or WAL bytes; a test shows each refuses with store_not_initialized on a file with no schema instead of initializing a store

completion.summary: ls, search, show in every form and every memories form now open the existing store read-only for each call (a fresh open_existing_read_only, never a writable fallback): no database or WAL writes, no write access needed to those files, and store_not_initialized instead of creating or initializing a store. Only the first unfiltered memories page that carries a context generation records, through the cached writable connection without process-default registration. Tests cover every read form with the database and WAL unwritable (including real evaluation details and every window continuation), every form refusing on absent, zero-byte and schemaless stores, and the CLI/MCP cold-store path; docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md lists the reads that record nothing. Landed as 31fc438 after three rounds (last: gate test-43e8e050 passed, both reviewers clean), installed build 400dc5f7; independent evaluation eaeb9e89 passed all three criteria.
